nodes.name: 5. CVE Enrichment Loop
nodes.notes: Query NVD CVE API for each service with rate limiting

parameters.content:
## Get CVE datas
**CPE Search** : https://nvd.nist.gov/products/cpe/search
**CVE Search** : https://services.nvd.nist.gov/rest/json/cves/2.0?cpeName={CPE Tag}&resultsPerPage=10&isVulnerable

## Dependency Check

Verifies nmap-helper installation (converts Nmap XML to JSON). First run installs from GitHub; subsequent runs skip this step.

https://github.com/net-shaper/nmap-helper

https://crates.io/crates/nmap-helper

## CVE Enrichment

Queries NVD API for each detected service using CPE identifiers. Returns CVE IDs, CVSS scores, severity levels, and references. Rate-limited to 1 req/sec.

parameters.command:
=prince /tmp/logs/vulnerability_report_{{$('1. Set Parameters').item.json.timestamp}}.html \
-o /tmp/logs/vulnerability_report_{{$('1. Set Parameters').item.json.timestamp}}.pdf \
--encrypt \
--key-bits=128 \
--user-password={{$('1. Set Parameters').item.json.report_password}}
